list.title: Catalog Imports
list.description: Submit Tiki category and product bundle files, then review bundles and related jobs.

detail.title: Catalog Import Job
detail.description: Inspect job progress, linked bundle data, validation issues, and follow-up actions.

upload.bundleDescription: Submit a product bundle only after its Tiki categories have been provisioned.
upload.invalidJson: The selected file is not valid JSON.

jobs.historyDescription: All CatalogService import operations appear here, including uploads, validation, seller provisioning, import, and retry jobs.
jobs.categoryHistoryDescription: Category provisioning submissions stay separate from the primary product-bundle table.
jobs.relatedDescription: Inspect submit, validate, seller provisioning, and import jobs for the selected bundle without leaving the list page.

bundles.historyDescription: Review paginated product bundles first, then inspect the selected bundle's related jobs from the side pane.

categories.provisioningDescription: Submit SellerCenter category output so CatalogService can create or match HiveSpace categories before product bundles are validated.
categories.linksDescription: Category links must exist before affected products can become ready.

sellers.name: Seller
sellers.approvalReasonRequired: Target user, target store, and approval reason are required.
sellers.approvalConfirmMessage: This links the external Tiki seller to an existing HiveSpace seller account and store. Existing store profile data will not be changed.

products.importAllReadyDescription: Imports every currently eligible product in the bundle without loading every page.

validation.description: Run follow-up jobs from the detail page and monitor each async operation to completion.

empty.relatedJobs: No jobs are linked to this bundle yet.
empty.relatedJobsSelection: Select a bundle to inspect its related jobs.
empty.categoryProvisioningJobDetail: This category provisioning job is tracked by job progress and result summary. Product bundle review sections are shown only for product import jobs.
empty.operationSections: No specialized sections are available for this import operation.

notifications.failed: The catalog import action could not be completed.
notifications.categoriesQueuedMessage: Category provisioning was queued in CatalogService.
notifications.bundleQueuedMessage: Product bundle submission was queued in CatalogService.
notifications.sellerApprovedMessage: The seller ownership link was saved. Re-run validation before importing affected products.
